title: Abba Elazar ben Gimel
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: (A Tanna of a baraita.) One baraita of his remains to us, cited several times in the Talmud, as in Beitzah 13b and Menachot 54b: “It was taught: Abba Elazar ben Gimel says, ‘And your terumah shall be reckoned to you,’” etc. Gittin 30b reads ben Gamla, and Bekhorot 58b ben Gomel. The source of the baraita is Sifrei, Korach, on “And it shall be reckoned,” and there it is Abba Elazar ben Gamliel (Gimel being an abbreviation of the name, in Hyman’s explanation), disagreeing there with Rabbi Yishmael.

notes.text: The consulted Beitzah 13b reads ben Gimel; Sifrei Bamidbar 121 reads ben Gamliel alongside Rabbi Yishmael. Hyman’s abbreviation explanation and statement that one baraita remains are not a new exhaustive attestation or identity finding.
